connector.contact_type: bottom contact (per Radxa ROCK 5A official wording); FH35C series body is a back-flip, top & bottom (dual-sided) contact connector, height 0.9mm - same family/mechanics as the project's existing camera seat FH35C-31S-0.3SHW(50), so the footprint can be derived from the 31-position one (31->39) but must be checked against the Hirose FH35C-39S land pattern
connector.cable: Radxa FPC AC013 / AC013N (39P 0.3mm to 40P 0.5mm, opposite side, plug-and-play, for Display 8 HD and 10 FHD)
connector.note_q6a: Dragon Q6A official pages state only '39-Pin / 0.3mm pitch FPC connector' (no part number). The Q6A schematic symbol J10/LCD_39P pin names are identical pin-for-pin to the ROCK 5C official table (including the GND1..GND9/GND11/GND12 numbering with no GND10), so the same Hirose part is inferred. [inferred, high confidence]

1.note: Panel main logic 3.3V supply (Q6A net VCC_3V3_LCD). Panel-side pin 2 (VDD 3.3V)
1.source: S1 ROCK 5C table; S4 Q6A schematic p.29

2.note: Panel IO supply, 1.8V or 3.3V selectable (Q6A: VCC_1V8 via R312 0R). Panel-side pin 3 (VCCIO)
2.source: S1 ROCK 5C table; S4 Q6A schematic p.29

3.note: Panel-side pin 4 = 'NC' with description 'INT 1' (gravity sensor interrupt 1). ROCK 5C leaves this position NULL; Dragon Q6A names it SENSOR-INT but does not connect it to any net on the Q6A board. Optional use on our board: panel gravity-sensor INT1

merge_40_to_39.rule: board_pin = panel_pin - 1 for panel pins 2..40; panel pin 1 (NC) has no counterpart. NO signal merging: every other panel pin maps 1:1 onto one board pin, in order.
merge_40_to_39.dropped_reason: proved by alignment (only the head NC can be removed without breaking the 1:1 mapping), by the two Radxa board-side pin tables (ROCK 5C 39-pin table and ROCK 4D SBC-side table) which both start at the panel's pin 2, and by the backlight pin count (2 cathodes + 2 anodes on both sides => nothing was merged)
merge_40_to_39.status: confirmed (not reverse-inferred): four independent Radxa-original sources agree

backlight.strings: 1 string, 2 LEDs in parallel (both cathodes land on one net, both anodes on one net - see Q6A: 34+35 = VCC_LEDK, 38+39 = VCC_LEDA)
backlight.official_spec_status: NOT FOUND (not published). Radxa's official Display 8 HD page gives only 'Backlight: White LED' and 'Luminance 300 type cd/m2'; no voltage/current/string count. Only the string structure could be derived from the pinout
official_spec_urls_tried: https://docs.radxa.com/en/accessories/display/lcd-8-hd/lcd-8-hd-product (LCD feature list: no backlight electrical data)
https://www.radxa.com/products/accessories/display-8hd (Tech Spec table not in the static HTML)

same_family_reference_10fhd.source: https://docs.radxa.com/en/accessories/display/lcd-10-fhd/lcd-10-fhd-product (Radxa Display 10 FHD official backlight physical parameters table) - REFERENCE ONLY, these are 10FHD values, not 8HD values

radxa_reference_design.implication: the 8HD LED rail is above 5V and therefore needs a boost stage - our board must provide its own backlight boost + current limit + PWM dimming
radxa_reference_design.note: the exact 8HD LED rail voltage/current is NOT published by Radxa - treat as [inferred, to be verified] and measure on the real panel

variant_15p.used_by: ROCK 3A / 3C / 4SE and Raspberry Pi 4B (the 39p->40p cable is used by ROCK 4C+ / 5A / 5B and Dragon Q6A)
variant_15p.cable: AC012 (15P 1.0mm to 40P 0.5mm, opposite side) - requires an additional 7-pin break-out header
variant_15p.backlight_evidence: backlight PWM and backlight 5V feed are on the 7-pin break-out, not on the 15-pin FPC; Radxa's own README states 'The backlight brightness of the current version is not adjustable'
variant_15p.dsi_lanes: the 8HD needs 2-lane or 4-lane MIPI DSI; the 15p variant is practically 2-lane (RPi 4B DSI is 2-lane). 15 positions cannot hold 4-lane DSI (10) + touch I2C (2) + TP_RST (1) + TP_INT (1) + power/ground and still leave room for backlight
variant_15p.pin_map_15p_side_status: NOT FOUND - Radxa publishes no pin table for the 15-pin side
variant_15p.conclusion: The 15p variant cannot carry 4-lane DSI + touch + backlight on one connector => our design must use the 39p variant (or a self-made cable). Touch RST/INT and backlight PWM would additionally need the 7-pin break-out wired by hand

unpublished_by_radxa: The 39p/0.3mm ribbon cable (AC013/AC013N) itself: no drawing or pin table published (https://docs.radxa.com/img/accessories/display/ac013-pin-definition.webp -> 404; only the 15p version's image ac012-pin-definition.webp exists). The 39p mapping above is therefore derived from the official board-side pin tables, cross-checked across four Radxa-original sources

J10 connector part number inside the Q6A schematic: the schematic only carries designator J10 and symbol name LCD_39P (schematic PDF, placement-map PDF: no part-number table; the 3D STEP zip download was truncated twice and could not be read)
The 8HD panel's own backlight voltage/current/string count: see backlight.official_spec_status
